opening.argument: The evidence presents an apparently low-barrier route to valuable branded rewards: “Enjoy your free mastercard gift cards!” appears alongside a Mastercard page displaying a code-like string and the message “Searching database for unused codes...”. A related flow promises that collecting 100 points produces a $100 Visa gift card, while directing viewers through surveys, purchases, age or case-status questions, and submission of a last name and primary phone number. These are not merely general descriptions: the pages visibly request personal information and answers while promoting a substantial reward. The presentation therefore supports the claimed reward-acquisition scheme. It does not establish that any code was valid, that information was submitted, or that any reward was delivered.

citations.quote: Enjoy your free mastercard gift cards!
